The '''Sotak city-clan''' was a clan composed of members of the [[Doneer]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[City/Legends|city]]-clan lived in [[Sotak'vik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doneer'so]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established their [[Sector/Legends|sector]] headquarters of the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] in Sotak'vik, leading the Sotaks to become fanatically loyal to the Empire.<ref name="CP" />
